floorPlans.note: Built-up totals include the balcony. Ranges follow the printed minimum and maximum figures. Confirm the area for the specific apartment.

review.gallery: 8 project renders from Nshama’s live project gallery. The selected original from the April 25, 2026 DLD album for project 4028 shows the foreground site. Buildings in the background are not identified as Fiori. Inspection index https://dubaihandover.com/projects/4028-fiori.
review.location: The project is marked on brochure physical page 8. The master-plan panel is shown separately from the community figures below it. The project-specific DLD point from Dubai Handover agrees with that part of the community. Nearby times are from physical page 6 and apply to Town Square.
review.floorPlans: All five sheets in the Nshama standalone floor-plan PDF. The site mentions duplex residences, but the reviewed official drawing set provides no duplex sheet. All selected printed built-up totals were visually checked. Minor rounding differences in displayed suite and balcony components are retained through the published total.

unavailable: Confirmed visitor entrance, completed-building photography and a complete duplex drawing set.
